questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the roadway. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red, eight-sided sign means you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in the direction you are heading.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up. This sign warns you that traffic will merge from the right side ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up. This sign warns you that a winding road with multiple curves is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards and conditions. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply (in this case, to the right). Slow down before reaching a sharp curve just as you would at an intersection turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a left turn at this location. Left turns are unsafe and illegal here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait until it is safe before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: You cannot pass other vehicles where this sign is posted. It is prohibited by law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop if needed. Give the right-of-way to vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow-green warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on conditions. Always slow down when road or weather conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead. Watch for pedestrians and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Turning right here is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. It shows the direction you must travel on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop completely before the stop sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and can cause you to lose control. This sign warns of wet pavement ahead. Slow down because wet roads require longer stopping distances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.
